help.main:
{{product}} ({{cli}}) v{{version}}

CLI control plane — utamakan --json untuk agen AI.
Docs: docs/agent/README.md · docs/cli/reference.md · docs/agent/commands.json

Pemakaian:
  {{cli}} <command> [options]

Perintah:
  setup                 Init dataDir + admin
  update                Cek/terapkan self-update
  serve                 HTTP API + Web UI
  system unit-install   Pasang ysk-server.service [--enable]
  tools                 Daftar tools; tools run --tool <name> [--dry-run]
  ask                   NL → rencana AI [--execute]
  projects              list|get|create|deploy|stop|health|backup|template
  backup                all|list|status|restore|delete|schedule|control-plane|settings|restic
  templates             Template aplikasi
  hosting               pembantu nginx|dns|db|firewall
  dns                   zone|zones (alias AI → hosting dns-*)
  logs                  sources|query|journal|overview
  host                  overview|metrics (hanya baca)
  nginx                 status|list|test|sync
  ssl                   list|get (sertifikat)
  db-cluster            list|get|create|plan (HA plan-first)
  ssh-key               list|create|import|public|export|install|delete (brankas identitas SSH)
  ssh-2fa               list|enroll|confirm|install|pam|retire (TOTP login SSH ≠ 2FA panel)
  services              Matriks layanan host (probe systemctl)
  defense | protection  status|ban|unban|whitelist
  security              status|sessions|api-keys (bendera 2FA · cabut sesi · kunci API)
  cdn                   nodes|sites|render|apply|purge|probe|dashboard|health-loop|from-project
  agents                runtimes|fleet list|commands|register (panel + edge)
  agent run             Poller armada keluar (eksperimental)
  store                 status|export|import|migrate (backend dokumen json|sqlite|postgres)
  files                 list|read|write|mkdir|rm|stat|rename|copy|move|chmod|trash|shares (sandbox)
  cron                  list|create|delete|enable|disable|run|install|status
  email                 domains|mailboxes|deliverability|bootstrap|dns (setara panel)
  health                Snapshot mode lokal atau --url http://host:port/health
  readiness | doctor    Kesiapan produksi (jujur)
  migrate               inventory|host|post|status|resume (migrasi host penuh)
  version | help

Global:
  --json                stdout JSON (AI)
  --data-dir PATH
  --config PATH
  --help | --version

Keluar: 0 ok · 1 error · 2 validation · 3 blocked · 4 not found · 5 host error

Keamanan:
  Operasi berbahaya default ke dry-run (rencana saja).
  Berikan --execute (alias --apply) + env YSK_EXECUTE=1 untuk mengubah host.

Contoh:
  {{cli}} readiness --json
  {{cli}} host --json
  {{cli}} nginx status --json
  {{cli}} ssl list --json
  {{cli}} projects get --id UUID --json
  {{cli}} defense ban --ip 1.2.3.4 --json          # rencana dry-run
  {{cli}} projects list --json
  {{cli}} logs query --source journal: --lines 100 --json
  {{cli}} tools --json
